source: hand-curated documents about teddyOS (Linux daily driver)

docs.b: teddyOS is a Linux daily driver: Debian plus Search, dock apps, and plain-language help. Open with make desktop (UTM on Apple Silicon). There is no freestanding Rust kernel in this product. Capability model: tools denied until granted. Messaging opens and drafts only — never auto-sends. No secrets in the tree.

Search is the main window: ask anything. It looks in your files (if allowed), online Guide from teddysearch, and this built-in help. Web escape hatch opens a browser when something is not on this computer. Stock tickers and guide pages come from the Guide crawl, not live trading advice.
Built-in help is a small offline corpus that ships with the image at /usr/share/teddyos/corpus.json. Turn it on or off in Setup. Missing file is quiet; a damaged file is explained in plain language.

Setup lets you grant Built-in help, Your files, and Search the web. Your files is enforced: only folders you pick are searchable. Search the web is enforced when the network sandbox is available. Built-in help is on/off only — the files sit on the machine either way.
Email, WhatsApp, and LinkedIn help open the app or site and draft with AI. You always paste and send. teddyOS never auto-sends mail or chats. Phone QR can open the real sign-in site on your phone.

Daily driver path: make linux-init, make linux-provision, make linux-product, then make desktop. Product install puts Search, dock tiles, theme, and this help corpus into the guest. Live ISO is make linux-iso.

Get help and Answers use AI in plain language. Ultracode mode appears when you ask coding questions. Multi-AI tools (Claude, Perplexity, Devin, Replit) open when connected. Never claim a message was sent for you.
teddyos-update applies a small software payload without reinstalling the whole machine. Auto-update stays off until Setup grants Keep teddyOS up to date.
Product dock order: Search, Web, WhatsApp, Email, Files. Web is Chromium. Look and brand scripts set wallpaper and theme so the guest does not look like plain Debian.

Online Guide ranking happens on this computer over a cached index. teddyOS asks teddysearch for the index; it does not send your typed query to fetch results. Workspace search stays local to folders you allow.
